entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv15855"/><div sID="gen30535" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv15855"/><hi type="bold">24. But the word grew, &c.--</hi>that is, Not only was the royal representative ignominiously swept from the stage, while his intended victim was spared to the Church, but the cause which he and his Jewish instigators sought to crush was only furthered and glorified. How full of encouragement and consolation is all this to the Christian Church in every age! <div eID="gen30535" type="x-p"/>
